definition: Hard-connecting two ~1°-off attitude endpoints over multiple polhode turns (3.1 on seed 119) bakes a large ω error (4.25°) into the shoot, forcing Band D — even though LM multistart on the EXACT pair is sound (Band A). Escaped by minimizing photometry over a forward window instead of hard-connecting endpoints (s106). Identified s105 as the binding blocker, displacing the earlier anchor-baseline-aliasing hypothesis.
